pages.text: Solenne's own panoply: flame-gold Sunsteel, a crown of rays and a slowly turning sun disc upon the back.$(br2)Worn whole, it wards you against $(l)fire and lava$() and lends you $(l)Strength$() while the sun is up. Forge each piece at the Convergence Altar under Sol light, with an iron piece as catalyst.
Solar Cuirass. Catalyst: an iron chestplate; offerings: four Sunsteel ingots and two blaze rods; 800 Sol light. The diadem and sabatons want glowstone and blaze rods, the tassets glowstone.
